test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf v3.0 RNN-T99 Server streaming-audio validation
test_case.purpose: Produce a compliant v3.0 RNN-T99 Server score with valid speech accuracy and streaming latency and compare to a matched reference.
required_package: Server audio preprocessing, accuracy, load/latency/duration settings
Comparable v3.0 reference and approved delta
test_case.test_command: Validate v3.0 hashes/licenses, RNN-T audio assets and GPU health; run the supported equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=rnnt --scenarios=server"`; execute speech accuracy and Server performance/latency validity stages; preserve LoadGen detail/summary, accuracy and telemetry; restore state and compare only with matched v3.0 RNN-T99 Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: RNN-T speech accuracy and Server latency/LoadGen validity pass, score meets approved delta and platform remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact v3.0 RNN-T99 Server identity, audio accuracy, latency validity and threshold. BERT/Offline/invalid/thresholdless output cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use licensed hashed v3.0 RNN-T/audio artifacts.
Verify Server streaming profile before launch.
Preserve all logs; no official-submission claim.
expected_evidence: Speech accuracy and LoadGen Server validity logs
test_case.recovery: If audio preprocessing, latency validity or model identity is wrong, stop the RNN-T run, retain audio/config/LoadGen diagnostics, restore container and GPU power state, and require corrected v3.0 RNN-T Server assets before any new execution.
